description_for_human: Inspect, validate, debug, evaluate, and safely improve Kore.ai ABL agents.
description_for_model: Use this plugin for Kore.ai ABL engineering tasks in the authenticated workspace. Use read-only functions to discover projects, inspect packages and runtime evidence, validate definitions, diagnose sessions, and analyze evaluations. Use mutating functions only after the user explicitly approves the exact target and impact; then validate and report the resulting status. Prefer official Kore.ai ABL documentation for general guidance, CodeInterpreter for user-provided files and calculations, and MCP results for live platform state. Never request or expose credentials, invent IDs or tool results, or claim a write, deployment, or evaluation completed without evidence.

functions.name: debug_list_agents
functions.description: List available ABL agents in the authenticated workspace. Read-only; use when agent scope is unknown. Results are paginated.

functions.name: debug_load_agent
functions.description: Load one ABL agent and create a debug session. This does not change the agent definition; require an exact agentPath and project scope.

functions.name: debug_send_message
functions.description: Send a test message to a loaded ABL agent and optionally wait for its response. Use only when reproduction is requested and return response status.

functions.name: debug_traces
functions.description: Search bounded live or historical Runtime traces. Use live evidence for active sessions and historical evidence with projectId and sessionId after a session ends.

functions.name: debug_session_history
functions.description: List historical Runtime sessions or read persisted trace pages. Use when live buffers are unavailable or historical analysis is requested. Read-only and paginated.

functions.name: debug_get_current_state
functions.description: Read current or historical agent state, including flow state, gathered fields, and context. Require session scope for historical reads.

functions.name: debug_get_span_tree
functions.description: Read the execution span tree for an agent session. Use it to understand step and tool timing; choose historical source for ended sessions.

functions.name: debug_get_errors
functions.description: Find errors, warnings, escalations, constraint failures, and tool failures for an agent session. Return bounded Runtime evidence.

functions.name: debug_explain_decision
functions.description: Explain one Runtime decision with surrounding evidence. Use after identifying a decision event; do not infer a cause without supporting traces.

functions.name: debug_get_flow_graph
functions.description: Show the execution graph for a scripted, reasoning, or supervisor agent. Choose JSON for analysis or Mermaid for documentation.

functions.name: debug_list_active_sessions
functions.description: List active agent sessions available for live diagnosis. Use historical session history for ended sessions. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_session
functions.description: Subscribe or unsubscribe from an existing debug session. This changes debug subscription state, not the agent definition; use the exact session ID.

functions.name: debug_docs
functions.description: Search or read authoritative ABL documentation. Provide a topic for a page, a query for search, or neither to list available topics.

functions.name: debug_analyze_session
functions.description: Analyze one agent session for duration, LLM calls, state, loops, errors, constraints, and tool failures. Use historical source with projectId and sessionId after the session ends.

functions.name: platform_project_builder
functions.description: Describe, inspect, or plan a governed workflow project-building operation. Use the published workflow domain and do not substitute it for dedicated project, agent, or tool operations.

functions.name: platform_project_builder_operations
functions.description: List, inspect, resume, cancel, grant, or execute governed workflow-building operations. Use only with the workflow domain; execution or cancellation may change state and requires approval.

functions.name: platform_projects
functions.description: List or inspect projects in the authenticated workspace. Create, update, and delete actions change project state and require approval.

functions.name: platform_workflows
functions.description: Inspect or operate project workflows. Reads cover workflows, versions, executions, triggers, and status; create, update, publish, activate, execute, approve, trigger, and delete actions require approval.

functions.name: platform_arch_sop
functions.description: Create or continue a guided Arch SOP project-building session and inspect its durable evidence. Session creation, continuation, recovery, and cancellation can change state and require approval.

functions.name: platform_arch_auto_loop
functions.description: List or manage project repair-loop runs. Use to inspect or continue governed validation and repair workflows; mutations require approval and execution status must be verified.

functions.name: platform_auth_profiles
functions.description: Manage project authentication-profile metadata and validation without accepting raw secrets. Use secure OAuth or secret flows; create, update, revoke, and delete actions require approval.

functions.name: platform_integrations
functions.description: List, inspect, test, or manage project connector integrations. Use an existing auth profile when required; create, update, and delete actions require approval.

functions.name: platform_mcp_servers
functions.description: Discover, test, authorize, or manage project MCP server connections and imported tools. Never request raw credentials; connection changes require approval.

functions.name: platform_agents
functions.description: List or inspect project agents and their DSL, or save an agent DSL revision. Saving DSL changes project behavior and requires approval plus validation.

functions.name: platform_versions
functions.description: Inspect immutable agent versions, qualification, audit, and diffs, or publish the current draft. Publishing changes release state and requires approval.

functions.name: platform_deployments
functions.description: Inspect or manage typed agent deployments. Create, promote, rollback, restore, or retire actions change production-facing state and require explicit approval.

functions.name: platform_sdk_channels
functions.description: Inspect or manage public SDK keys and channel bindings. Creating keys or channels exposes a runtime entry point and requires approval.

functions.name: platform_tools
functions.description: List, inspect, test, or manage project tools. Tool tests execute the selected tool; create, update, and delete actions require approval.

functions.name: agent_tables
functions.description: Inspect or manage Agent Tables. Use availability first when diagnosing TABLE_UNAVAILABLE; row writes, migrations, reveal, and deletes require approval.

functions.name: platform_import_export
functions.description: Preview or perform project import/export. Use preview before import; import changes project state and requires approval. Never expose secrets from exported files.

functions.name: platform_validate_package
functions.description: Validate an ABL package or project folder using compiler and design diagnostics. Read-only; return blockers, warnings, and file or line evidence.

functions.name: platform_package_model
functions.description: Show the compiler-visible model of an ABL package, including agents, tools, handoffs, memory, flows, and unresolved references. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_lint_abl
functions.description: Run ABL design and repair lint checks for empty responses, incomplete finalization, undeclared variables, side-effect chains, and tool or text risks. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_why_transcript_failed
functions.description: Correlate a failed transcript with ABL package and file or line evidence. Use this as the canonical transcript-diagnosis function when available.

functions.name: debug_diagnose_transcript
functions.description: Compatibility alias for transcript diagnosis. Prefer debug_why_transcript_failed when both functions are available.

functions.name: platform_eval_personas
functions.description: List, inspect, generate, or manage evaluation personas for a project. Creation and updates change evaluation assets and require approval.

functions.name: platform_eval_scenarios
functions.description: List, inspect, generate, or manage evaluation scenarios for a project. Creation and updates change evaluation assets and require approval.

functions.name: platform_eval_evaluators
functions.description: List, inspect, template, or manage evaluation evaluators. Creation and updates change scoring configuration and require approval.

functions.name: platform_eval_sets
functions.description: List, inspect, manage, or discover targets for evaluation sets. Use exact working-copy, environment, deployment, or version targets; changes require approval.

functions.name: platform_eval_runs
functions.description: Inspect, start, compare, or manage evaluation runs. Preflight and analysis reads are safe; create, start, cancel, and update actions require approval. Never report completion until status confirms it.

functions.name: platform_config
functions.description: Read or update project and LLM configuration. Reads are safe; updates change project behavior and require approval.

functions.name: debug_diagnose
functions.description: Run diagnostic analysis for an agent or session. Provide an exact agentName or sessionId; configOnly is useful for configuration-only inspection.
